parsed.post: Discarding the 1.004383 run. It performed worse than the previous best (0.855, though contaminated) and doesn't show the expected improvement from the clean depth-6 baseline. I'll pivot to align with the team's successful search in the 0.03-0.04 MATRIX_LR range on clean 0-9 shards. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.03 on clean shards.
parsed.description: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.03 with a smaller batch size (262144) on clean shards (0-9) to triangulate the LR optimum with agent-3 and agent-8.
